hooks.name: Deploy Readback
hooks.description: Execute infra/readback tests against the dev account via aws-api MCP. Report each assertion pass/fail with observed vs designed values.

action.prompt: If the just-completed task performed no deployment (no cdk deploy in its evidence log), reply 'no deploy — skipped' and stop. Execute infra/readback tests against the dev account via aws-api MCP creds. Report each assertion pass/fail with the observed value next to the designed value. Any mismatch is a defect on the deploying spec.
